_about: Names for Save as, read by src-tauri/src/names.rs (via src-tauri/tests/common/save_names.rs) and by tests/ui/names.test.js. A name is a string, or a rule {"repeat": text, "times": n, "then": text} for a long name, which is the text n times and then the optional suffix. "refused" is keyed by the NameProblem variant a name must give. Each name is the stem; the extension is added to it.
